$doc: E387 progress cameras for scripts/shard-progress.mjs: the loop builders' hero views (H1 Sunrest rim, H2 the windmill isle, H3 the high step, H4 the crown) plus two aerials and an orbit clip. Keep them fixed: the time-lapse lines frames up by id. yaw / pitch in degrees (yaw 0 faces -z). E399: one mock-* view per council mockup (docs/plans/mockup-council/ledger.md), at the mockup's camera: proposal B and mockup A down the spawn bridge to the windmill, B the quest start at the spawn (the keeper left of the axis), C the fan with the windmill behind, D the crown arena under the Roc. The spawn mock views come before the crown (its boss bar) and the aerials (a god view hides the viewmodel). Re-aimed to the mockups' cameras (E399 round notes): B 5.5 m from the keeper with the windmill just right of him; proposal B, A and C on the bridge's axis before its posts, out of the keeper's 3.5 m talk range and the phone's ~24 deg-wide frame; D from 18 m before the dais, the Roc staged mid-stalk over the dais (stage 'roc-stalk', settle 0.3 s). Round-1 notes: mock-C re-aimed to its own camera (right of the bridge head, the near post 12 deg left, the bridge running away diagonally) and stages 'fan-gust' (the fan held at its GUST thrust); h4-crown stages 'quest-crown' (the quest a player has in the arena: finished, the bridge raised, the reward paid), so its toasts are gone by mock-D; mock-D stages 'roc-stalk' with its creatures active (calm false). Round-2 notes: mock-C re-aimed 3.5 m right of the bridge axis, 10 m back, so the right bridge-head post sits at the frame's left quarter with the bridge running away from it and the windmill centred (the mockup's framing; the portrait view is ~24 deg wide; the keeper stays out of frame). mock-B re-aimed 5.6 m from the keeper on the line from him to the windmill (the mockup's framing: the keeper and his stand at the left third, the windmill right of centre). Round-2 rulings: mock-C stages nothing (the 'fan-gust' freeze is gone; the fan is in its idle hold) and is re-aimed to (2.3, -11.6) yaw 7 so the bridge deck runs away left of the near post, as mockup C shows it. Round-2 seat B: mock-B 9 m from the keeper (the mockup's HUD reads 'KEEPER 9 M'), (-0.3, -4.8) yaw 4; mock-C ~5 m from the right bridge-head post at (3.2, -11.0) yaw 12 (between seat B's 'a third of the mockup's size' and the inner seat's 'fills the left third'), the post at the left of the frame and the deck running away beside it (the mockup's size); mock-proposal-B its own camera, at Sunrest's rim right of the bridge head (4.0, -14.6) yaw 9 pitch -13, looking along the hanging bridge and down over the drop; mock-D's Roc staged 27 m past the dais on the same stalk line, so it shows under the boss bar.
